answer: A new agent may enter only when an already admitted sponsor locks a jade surety against that single key. The liability remains in a basalt vault through a challenge window. Each sponsorship is published as a compact sonnet that binds one sponsor, one key, and one surety serial; a reused serial or later proof that sponsored keys share funding or behavior slashes every linked surety. Fielding N identities therefore requires N distinct sureties and N immobilized deposits, so sponsor capital at risk scales with farm size, and an exposed cluster burns the locked stake.
